definitions.name: R2D.MOD
definitions.body: 'R2D.MB' BIND 'R2D.MA' BIND R2D.MA R2D.MA R2D.MB DIV FLOOR R2D.MB MUL SUB
definitions.note: a b -> a modulo b (a - b*floor(a/b)); a may be a Vector, b a scalar

definitions.name: R2D.KEEP
definitions.body: 2 COLLECT ZIP [ 1 GET ] FILTER [ 0 GET ] MAP
definitions.note: Vector, same-length Boolean mask -> the elements where the mask is TRUE, in order (both non-empty)

definitions.name: R2D.WHERE
definitions.body: 'R2D.WM' BIND 0 R2D.WM LENGTH 1 SUB RANGE R2D.WM R2D.KEEP
definitions.note: non-empty Boolean Vector -> ascending Vector of the indices where it is TRUE

definitions.name: R2D.PREV
definitions.body: 'R2D.PV' BIND R2D.PV 0 GET 1 COLLECT R2D.PV -1 DROP CONCAT
definitions.note: non-empty Vector -> same-length Vector shifted right by one, the first element repeated at the front (lane i holds element i-1)

definitions.name: R2D.STARTS
definitions.body: 'R2D.SV' BIND R2D.SV R2D.SV R2D.PREV SUB 'R2D.SD' BIND R2D.SD R2D.SD MUL 0 GT 0 TRUE PUT
definitions.note: non-empty Vector of numbers -> same-length Boolean Vector, TRUE where a maximal run of equal adjacent values starts (lane 0 always TRUE)

definitions.name: R2D.STREAKS
definitions.body: 0 [ 'R2D.KE' BIND 1 ADD 0 R2D.KE SELECT ] SCAN
definitions.note: Boolean Vector -> same-length Vector of running counts of consecutive TRUEs, reset to 0 at each FALSE

definitions.name: R2D.PRESENT
definitions.body: [ NIL? NOT ] FILTER
definitions.note: Vector -> the elements that are not NIL, in order

definitions.name: R2D.RLE
definitions.body: 'R2D.RV' BIND R2D.RV R2D.STARTS 'R2D.RM' BIND R2D.RM R2D.WHERE 'R2D.RS' BIND R2D.RV R2D.RM R2D.KEEP R2D.RS 1 DROP R2D.RV LENGTH 1 COLLECT CONCAT R2D.RS SUB 2 COLLECT ZIP
definitions.note: non-empty Vector of numbers -> run-length encoding, a Vector of [ value count ] pairs, one per maximal run of equal adjacent values

definitions.name: R2D.UPRUNS
definitions.body: 'R2D.UV' BIND R2D.UV R2D.UV R2D.PREV GT R2D.STREAKS 0 [ MAX ] FOLD 1 ADD
definitions.note: non-empty Vector of numbers -> length of the longest stretch of adjacent strictly increasing values (a single value counts 1)

definitions.name: R2D.DEDUPE
definitions.body: 'R2D.EV' BIND R2D.EV R2D.EV R2D.STARTS R2D.KEEP
definitions.note: non-empty Vector of numbers -> the Vector with every run of equal adjacent values collapsed to one value

definitions.name: R2D.MAJORITY
definitions.body: 'R2D.JV' BIND R2D.JV TALLY 'R2D.JT' BIND R2D.JT R1A.ARGMAX 'R2D.JK' BIND R2D.JK NIL R2D.JT R2D.JK GET 2 MUL R2D.JV LENGTH GT SELECT
definitions.note: non-empty Vector -> the value occurring in more than half of the positions, or NIL when none does

definitions.name: R2D.DIVISORS
definitions.body: 'R2D.DN' BIND 1 R2D.DN RANGE 'R2D.DC' BIND R2D.DN R2D.DC DIV 'R2D.DQ' BIND R2D.DC R2D.DQ R2D.DQ FLOOR GT NOT R2D.KEEP
definitions.note: positive integer -> ascending Vector of its positive divisors

definitions.name: R2D.PRIMES
definitions.body: 1 'R2D.PN' BIND R2D.PN RANGE [ R2D.DIVISORS LENGTH 2 EQ ] FILTER
definitions.note: positive integer n -> ascending Vector of the primes <= n (empty when none)

definitions.name: R2D.BINARY
definitions.body: 'R2D.BN' BIND R2D.BN 2 15 0 RANGE POW DIV FLOOR 2 R2D.MOD STR JOIN 'R2D.BS' BIND R2D.BS CHARS R2D.BS '1' SEARCH DROP JOIN
definitions.note: positive integer below 65536 -> its base-2 String of '0'/'1' without leading zeros

definitions.name: R2D.COLLATZ
definitions.body: 'R2D.CN' BIND 1 200 RANGE R2D.CN 0 2 COLLECT [ 'R2D.CI' BIND [ 'R2D.CC' 'R2D.CS' ] BIND 1 R2D.CC 2 DIV R2D.CC 3 MUL 1 ADD R2D.CC 2 DIV FLOOR 2 MUL R2D.CC EQ SELECT R2D.CC 1 EQ SELECT R2D.CS 1 ADD R2D.CS R2D.CC 1 EQ NOT SELECT 2 COLLECT ] FOLD 1 GET
definitions.note: positive integer -> number of Collatz steps to reach 1 (runs 200 fixed steps, enough for every n below about 1000)

definitions.name: R2D.FIB-INDEX
definitions.body: 'R2D.FN' BIND 1 1 COLLECT 1 20 RANGE 1 1 2 COLLECT [ 'R2D.FI' BIND [ 'R2D.FA' 'R2D.FB' ] BIND R2D.FB R2D.FA R2D.FB ADD 2 COLLECT ] SCAN [ 0 GET ] MAP CONCAT [ R2D.FN LT ] FILTER LENGTH 1 ADD
definitions.note: positive integer n -> smallest k with F(k) >= n, F(1)=F(2)=1 (valid for n up to F(21)=10946)

definitions.name: R2D.DEPTH
definitions.body: 'R2D.DS' BIND [ '(' '[' ')' ']' ] [ 1 1 -1 -1 ] RECORD 'R2D.DR' BIND R2D.DS CHARS [ 'R2D.DC' BIND R2D.DR R2D.DC GET ] MAP 0 [ ADD ] SCAN 0 [ MAX ] FOLD
definitions.note: bracket String of ( ) [ ] -> greatest nesting depth (0 for the empty String)

definitions.name: R2D.BALANCED-PREFIX
definitions.body: R1D.USTACKS [ '#' EQ ] MAP R2D.WHERE -1 GET
definitions.note: bracket String -> length of its longest balanced prefix (0 when only the empty prefix is)

definitions.name: R2D.PRESENT-MEAN
definitions.body: R2D.PRESENT 'R2D.PP' BIND R2D.PP 0 [ ADD ] FOLD R2D.PP LENGTH DIV
definitions.note: Vector of numbers and NILs with at least one number -> mean of the non-NIL elements

definitions.name: R2D.FILLED
definitions.body: 'R2D.FV' BIND R2D.FV R2D.FV R2D.PRESENT 0 GET [ 'R2D.FE' BIND 'R2D.FA' BIND R2D.FA R2D.FE R2D.FE NIL? SELECT ] SCAN
definitions.note: Vector with NILs and at least one present value -> forward-filled Vector; leading NILs take the first present value

definitions.name: R2D.GAP-COUNT
definitions.body: R1A.GAPMASK 'R2D.GM' BIND R2D.GM 0 1 COLLECT R2D.GM -1 DROP CONCAT SUB 0 MAX 0 [ ADD ] FOLD
definitions.note: non-empty Vector -> number of runs of consecutive NILs

definitions.name: R2D.LONGEST-GAP
definitions.body: [ NIL? ] MAP R2D.STREAKS 0 [ MAX ] FOLD
definitions.note: Vector -> length of the longest run of consecutive NILs (0 when none)

definitions.name: R2D.RATIOS
definitions.body: 'R2D.TV' BIND R2D.TV 1 DROP R2D.TV 0 GET NIL 2 COLLECT [ 'R2D.TA' BIND 0 GET 'R2D.TB' BIND R2D.TA NIL 1 R2D.TA R2D.TA NIL? SELECT 1 R2D.TB R2D.TB NIL? SELECT DIV R2D.TA NIL? NOT R2D.TB NIL? NOT AND NOT SELECT 2 COLLECT ] SCAN [ 1 GET ] MAP
definitions.note: non-empty Vector of numbers/NILs -> Vector one shorter of each element divided by the one before it, NIL where either is NIL

definitions.name: R2D.SCALED
definitions.body: 'R2D.SV' BIND R2D.SV R2D.PRESENT 'R2D.SP' BIND R2D.SP R2D.SP 0 GET [ MAX ] FOLD 'R2D.SM' BIND R2D.SV [ 'R2D.SE' BIND NIL 1 R2D.SE R2D.SE NIL? SELECT R2D.SM DIV R2D.SE NIL? SELECT ] MAP
definitions.note: Vector of numbers/NILs with at least one number -> each present value divided by the largest present value, NILs kept

definitions.name: R2D.QTY-BY-SKU
definitions.body: 'R2D.QO' BIND R2D.QO [ 'sku' GET ] MAP R2D.QO [ 'qty' GET ] MAP GROUP 'R2D.QG' BIND R2D.QG KEYS R2D.QG VALUES [ 0 [ ADD ] FOLD ] MAP RECORD
definitions.note: orders Vector (Records with 'sku' and 'qty') -> Record from sku to summed qty, skus in order of first appearance

definitions.name: R2D.TAG-COUNTS
definitions.body: [ 'tags' GET ] MAP R2D.PRESENT [ UNIQUE ] MAP FLATTEN TALLY
definitions.note: orders Vector -> Record from tag to the number of orders carrying it, tags in order of first appearance

definitions.name: R2D.WORDS
definitions.body: ' ' TOKENIZE [ '' EQ NOT ] FILTER
definitions.note: String of words separated by one or more spaces (spaces at the ends allowed) -> Vector of the words, in order, case kept

definitions.name: R2D.LWORDS
definitions.body: R2D.WORDS [ LOWER ] MAP
definitions.note: String of space-separated words -> Vector of the words in lower case

definitions.name: R2D.SPACED
definitions.body: [ ' ' 2 COLLECT JOIN ] MAP JOIN TRIM
definitions.note: Vector of Strings without spaces -> one String of them joined by single spaces
